messages:
sam: Thanks all for joining the quick post‑all‑hands Q&A thread. Two quick asks: 1) Why are we winning some deals and losing others? 2) What are the top customer asks we should act on?

mira: From Sales POV — wins = performance + simple SLAs + strong pilot support. Losses = pricing inflex, long legal SOWs, and missing private options for regulated customers.

alex: CS data supports that. Top asks I see: VPC/on‑prem option, longer metrics/log retention, and clearer performance SLAs. Customers also want predictable fallbacks if a big model spikes latency.

devin: Engineering note — we're rolling KV cache improvements in the next runtime release which should cut p95 by ~20% for long chat sessions. PR tracking: `perf/kv-cache` (will share link).

ben: From Research/Optimize side — customers ask for better guardrails and reranking tools. A few lost deals specifically called out hallucination risk for critical content.

natalie: Useful signals. Leadership priorities I’m proposing: (A) accelerate Private (VPC/on‑prem) roadmap item, (B) formalize latency/availability SLOs customers can buy, (C) pricing playbook for mid‑market vs enterprise. I’ll draft a plan.

ci-bot: action created: TICKET-4832 "Pricing playbook draft" assigned to mira.

sam: Can we get owners and deadlines? Mira, will you own pricing playbook? Devin, can Eng own perf SLO plan? Alex, CS to produce top 10 asks and sample prompts?

mira: I can own pricing playbook. Need a short working session with Finance + Solutions Eng.

alex: CS will compile top 10 asks + example customer prompts and share by EOW (Friday). Will include signal tags: 'security', 'latency', 'features'.

devin: Eng will aim to publish perf SLO proposal and benchmark updates by next Wednesday. Will include microbench and a few real customer traces.

ben: I'll link customer eval suites to Redwood Optimize and flag regression alerts for any rollout. Please tag me on evals.

deploy-bot: Meeting notes uploaded: https://redwood.internal/notes/1796123456‑debrief (access: redwood/all‑hands).

sam: Quick followup: can each owner add a 2‑line status to the ticket by EOD Monday so we have something to present next week?

mira: Yup — will add owner + proposed timeline.

natalie: Thanks everyone. I'll schedule a small working group to finalize scope for Private + SLOs. @mira @devin @alex please DM availability.

sam: I'll draft the short roadmap note and share a follow‑up doc by Friday afternoon.

mira: :thumbsup: thanks team — CS will also surface any recent loss postmortems to help with messaging and case studies.

alex: One last small ask from a few customers — improve visibility into token-level billing per request. That might help some procurement conversations.

devin: Noted. We can add a telemetry flag to expose per-request token breakdown in the Console; will scope with Product.

sam: Great thread — short, actionable. Closing here but will update the ticket once the first drafts are in.
